statusDetail: Coverage-complete multi-template public-site audit. Not covered: authenticated account management, destructive account actions, property enquiry submission, and private seller checkout because they require credentials, personal data, or irreversible external contact.

page.notes: Public South African property marketplace. Representative home, listing, detail, editorial, calculator and error templates audited.

findings.summary: Dark preference is ignored
findings.evidence: The dark-mode capture is pixel-identical to light mode; the probe reports colorScheme "normal" and body rgb(246,246,246) under prefers-color-scheme: dark.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and retint surfaces/text with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: State and route changes lack modern transition treatment
findings.evidence: CSS feature inspection found no view-transition usage across the homepage styles; route and custom overlay state changes are abrupt.
findings.suggestedFix: Add progressive View Transitions for route/detail and major state changes, while preserving reduced-motion behavior.

findings.summary: Custom overlays are manually positioned rather than platform anchored
findings.evidence: DOM recon found custom role=dialog divs and feature inspection found no anchor positioning or popover primitives.
findings.suggestedFix: Use popover/dialog semantics and CSS anchor positioning with position-try fallbacks for transient anchored UI.

findings.summary: Cookie notice blocks core content on every audited template
findings.evidence: Desktop screenshots show a large modal-like cookie notice covering the homepage search, listing results, article content and calculator controls; it offers only Close.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace the blocking notice with a non-obscuring, accessible consent surface; use dialog/popover semantics and clear choices where consent is required.

findings.summary: All templates render a desktop-width canvas on mobile
findings.evidence: At 360px, every measured template reports scrollWidth/innerWidth 1241px and 881px horizontal overflow; captures show clipped search, tabs and content.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove desktop-width forcing, honor device viewport sizing, and use intrinsic/fluid layout with responsive components.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is not visibly indicated
findings.evidence: The calculator focus probe reports outline "none 3px" and no box-shadow for the first focusable control.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide a high-contrast :focus-visible indicator and verify a complete keyboard focus walk.

findings.summary: Primary content loads too slowly
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 8.7s (performance .62); the independent trace measured FCP 5.93s and LCP 6.97s.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP resource, shorten render-blocking chains, defer non-critical scripts and verify against the 2.5s LCP target.

findings.summary: The page ships a heavy, weakly prioritized resource graph
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 132 requests/3.14MB, including 1.48MB third-party; Lighthouse flags 970ms render-blocking savings, 650KiB unused JS and 134KiB unused CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Split/defer unused code, delay third parties, reduce render-blocking CSS, and prioritize only the actual LCP resource.

findings.summary: Core controls and content have accessibility semantics failures
findings.evidence: axe found critical ARIA parent/value failures and missing image alts; Lighthouse also reports unnamed links/selects/inputs and no main landmark.
findings.suggestedFix: Repair tab semantics, label all controls, name links, add meaningful alt text and introduce a main landmark.

findings.summary: Text and action contrast fails WCAG AA
findings.evidence: axe measured contrast as low as 2.31:1 for tab text and 3.76:1 for the Search action, below 4.5:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust foreground/surface tokens to meet WCAG AA in every state and rerun axe.

findings.summary: Viewport policy and reflow prevent usable zoomed/mobile presentation
findings.evidence: Lighthouse fails meta-viewport scaling and the 360px evidence retains a 1241px layout canvas with 881px overflow.
findings.suggestedFix: Allow user scaling and implement true reflow at 320 CSS px and 400% zoom.

findings.summary: Console errors and deprecated API usage remain
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports browser console errors on homepage and calculator and one deprecated API warning.
findings.suggestedFix: Resolve runtime errors and replace the deprecated API; keep regression coverage on representative templates.

findings.summary: Cookie and policy defenses are incomplete
findings.evidence: HTTPS, HSTS, nosniff, frame protection and a minimal CSP are present, but Permissions-Policy is absent; eight of ten cookies are flagged for Secure/SameSite posture.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a least-privilege Permissions-Policy and tighten cookie Secure, SameSite and lifetime settings according to purpose.

findings.summary: Tracking starts before meaningful consent
findings.evidence: The initial load contacts 15 third-party origins and five known trackers, transfers 1.48MB third-party, and sets analytics cookies while the notice only offers Close.
findings.suggestedFix: Gate non-essential analytics until informed choice, reduce vendors, batch events and shorten identifiers/lifetimes.

findings.summary: Install/offline metadata is non-functional
findings.evidence: The manifest contains only GCM sender metadata, no start_url/name/icons, and the calculator probe reports no controlling service worker.
findings.suggestedFix: If installability is intended, provide a complete manifest and offline fallback; otherwise remove the misleading manifest link and document online-only intent.

findings.summary: Sign-in and calculator inputs lack trustworthy assistance
findings.evidence: DOM recon shows sign-in email/password inputs with empty autocomplete tokens; visible calculator text inputs have no associated labels.
findings.suggestedFix: Add correct autocomplete tokens (email/current-password) and explicit labels/input modes for calculator fields.

findings.summary: Third-party and image work is disproportionate
findings.evidence: HAR shows 1.48MB third-party transfer; image audit finds 34 below-fold images not lazy, 25 without srcset and eight legacy-format images.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer third parties and below-fold media, add responsive sources/dimensions, and enforce a purpose-specific page-weight budget.

findings.summary: Listing starts with a very large object/DOM footprint
findings.evidence: Heap summary starts at 900,928 nodes and 46.94MB self size. Repeated interactions add only 0.5%, so no leak was shown, but the initial footprint is disproportionate for one listing page.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce initial DOM/object population through pagination/virtualization and remove inactive duplicated UI; profile constructor retainers.

findings.summary: Dialog-like UI uses ad-hoc divs
findings.evidence: Recon found role=dialog divs but no native dialog, popover or details primitives on the homepage/calculator.
findings.suggestedFix: Move modal flows to <dialog> and transient controls to popover/details with declarative light-dismiss.

findings.summary: Images lack intrinsic dimensions
findings.evidence: The images primitive reports all 61 homepage images lack width and height; Lighthouse also fails unsized-images.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit intrinsic width/height or aspect-ratio for every image and preserve responsive sizing.

findings.summary: Property capabilities are not exposed as structured agent tools
findings.evidence: The public property portal has agent-relevant search/calculator/contact capabilities, but DOM and feature probes found no WebMCP or agent-tool registration.
findings.suggestedFix: Expose narrowly scoped, confirmable search and calculator capabilities through structured agent tools while keeping sensitive contact actions user-controlled.

findings.summary: Rich entity metadata is incomplete
findings.evidence: Homepage recon found Open Graph tags but zero JSON-LD blocks despite representing an organization/property-search service.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate Organization/WebSite JSON-LD and validate property-detail structured data against visible content.
